cards.headline: Exact controls are useful; realism remains a separate job.
good_fit: Rough brushed gold, copper, chrome, and satin metallic shaders in PBR engines (Cycles, Filament, Unreal, Three.js MeshPhysicalMaterial)
Explaining why single-scattering GGX discards photons that bounce to neighboring microfacets and loses up to 41.19% energy at alpha=1.0
Restoring exact White Furnace energy conservation and Helmholtz reciprocity via Kulla-Conty directional albedo compensation
Replacing per-pixel Monte Carlo furnace quadrature with closed-form rational polynomial albedo fits
not_for: Mirror-smooth specular surfaces (alpha < 0.05) where single-scattering already reflects > 99.9% of incident energy
Pure Lambertian matte diffuse surfaces without microfacet specular lobes
Neural radiance fields (NeRF) or neural material appearance synthesis models
Unlit flat UI sprites and 2D vector graphics
